_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "generation" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "region" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "type" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_es" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "egg_group" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_es" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ability" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_es" TEXT NULL, "short_effect" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "move" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type_id" INTEGER NULL, "power" INTEGER NULL, "accuracy" INTEGER NULL, "pp" INTEGER NULL, "priority" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "damage_class_id" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "version_group" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "generation_id" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "type_efficacy" ("attacking_type_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "defending_type_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "factor" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("attacking_type_id", "defending_type_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "species" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "generation_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES generation (id), "evolution_chain_id" INTEGER NULL, "is_legendary" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_legendary" IN (0, 1)), "is_mythical" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_mythical" IN (0, 1)), "name_es" TEXT NULL, "genus_es" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "species_egg_group" ("species_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES species (id), "egg_group_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES egg_group (id), PRIMARY KEY ("species_id", "egg_group_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pokemon" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "species_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES species (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_default" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_default" IN (0, 1)), "height" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "weight" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "base_stat_total" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "sprite_url" TEXT NULL, "artwork_url" TEXT NULL, "sprite_shiny_url" TEXT NULL, "artwork_shiny_url" TEXT NULL, "content_hash" TEXT NULL, "light_synced_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "detail_synced_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pokemon_type" ("pokemon_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES pokemon (id), "slot" INTEGER NOT NULL, "type_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES type (id), PRIMARY KEY ("pokemon_id", "slot"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pokemon_stat" ("pokemon_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES pokemon (id), "stat_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "base_stat" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("pokemon_id", "stat_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pokemon_ability" ("pokemon_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES pokemon (id), "slot" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ability_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES ability (id), "is_hidden" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_hidden" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("pokemon_id", "slot"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pokemon_move" ("pokemon_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES pokemon (id), "move_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES move (id), "version_group_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES version_group (id), "learn_method_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "level" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("pokemon_id", "move_id", "version_group_id", "learn_method_id", "level"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "evolution" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "chain_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "from_species_id" INTEGER NULL, "to_species_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "to_species_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "trigger" TEXT NULL, "min_level" INTEGER NULL, "min_happiness" INTEGER NULL, "time_of_day" TEXT NULL, "item" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pokemon_form" ("pokemon_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "species_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES species (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "form_name" TEXT NULL, "is_default" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_default" IN (0, 1)), "is_mega" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_mega" IN (0, 1)), "type1_id" INTEGER NULL, "type2_id" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("pokemon_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "favorite" ("pokemon_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "artwork_local_path" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("pokemon_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user_preference" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_metadata" ("resource_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_success_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_attempt_at" INTEGER NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "next_retry_at" INTEGER NULL, "cursor_offset" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_error" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("resource_key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "api_call_log" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "operation" TEXT NOT NULL, "called_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "http_status" INTEGER NULL);
CREATE INDEX idx_species_generation_id ON species (generation_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_species_egg_group_egg_group_id ON species_egg_group (egg_group_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_pokemon_species_id ON pokemon (species_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_pokemon_base_stat_total ON pokemon (base_stat_total)
CREATE INDEX idx_pokemon_type_type_id ON pokemon_type (type_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_pokemon_ability_ability_id ON pokemon_ability (ability_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_evolution_chain_id ON evolution (chain_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_pokemon_form_species_id ON pokemon_form (species_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_api_call_log_called_at ON api_call_log (called_at)
